title: Agent Authenticator: Passkey-Grade, Hardware-Bound Authentication for AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.19536v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding agents now push code, publish packages, call model APIs and operate cloud resources on behalf of developers. They authenticate to these services with the same bearer secrets humans use, personal access tokens, API keys and package-registry tokens, stored where the model, its subprocesses and any co-resident malware can read them. Incidents in 2025 and 2026, including prompt-injection attacks on coding agents and self-propagating supply-chain worms, show that this arrangement fails in predictable ways. Passkeys solved the analogous problem for humans, but they require a human gesture on every use and cannot be operated by an autonomous process. We present the Agent Authenticator, a design that gives agents passkey-grade authentication properties: per-service hardware-bound keys, no shared secrets, origin binding enforced by the runtime rather than the model, normalized attestation of the execution environment, human-signed sco

translated_title: Agent Authenticator：面向AI智能体的通行密钥级、硬件绑定认证
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体现在可以代表开发者推送代码、发布软件包、调用模型API以及操作云资源。它们使用与人类相同的持有者凭证进行身份验证——即个人访问令牌、API密钥和软件包注册表令牌——而这些凭据存储在模型本身、其子进程以及任何共驻恶意软件都能读取的位置。2025年和2026年发生的安全事件，包括针对编程智能体的提示注入攻击和自我传播的供应链蠕虫，表明这种安排会以可预见的方式失效。通行密钥已经为人类解决了类似的问题，但它们每次使用都需要人工手势确认，无法由自主进程操作。我们提出了Agent Authenticator，这是一种赋予智能体通行密钥级认证属性的设计：面向每个服务的硬件绑定密钥、无共享密钥、由运行时而非模型强制执行的来源绑定、执行环境的规范化证明以及人工签名的作用域……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Agent Authenticator设计，通过为AI智能体提供每个服务独立的硬件绑定密钥、无共享密钥以及由运行时强制执行的来源绑定等通行密钥级认证属性，解决了AI编程智能体因使用人类持有者凭证（如API密钥和访问令牌）而易受提示注入和供应链攻击的安全问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Agent Authenticator, a design that grants AI agents passkey-grade authentication properties—including per-service hardware-bound keys, no shared secrets, and runtime-enforced origin binding—to address the security risks arising from agents using human bearer credentials vulnerable to prompt injection and supply-chain attacks.
